capabilities: Customize per-folder colors via Style Settings
Export styles to a CSS snippet instead of DOM injection
Keep styling when folders are renamed
extras: Warns that some styles may break when disabling the plugin because it injects the folder path into nav-folder elements for performance instead of using :has. Available in English and French, with instructions for adding translations.
intentEvidence: This plugin requires the Style Settings plugin to customize folder colors.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to give root folders distinct colors, making it harder to visually tell top-level folders apart.

relations.evidence: This plugin requires the Style Settings plugin to customize folder colors.

summary: Folder styling plugin that automatically applies customizable colors to root-level folders, configured through the Style Settings plugin.
